title: Plant Manager, Composite Resources
text:
About Re:Build 
 At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. 

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. 

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles ) 
 
About Re:Build Composite Resources
 Composite Resources, a Re:Build Manufacturing company, is an innovative, rapidly growing manufacturer of composite components and tooling located in Rock Hill, SC. Our constantly evolving portfolio of projects includes parts and assemblies for clients in the aerospace and defense industries. At Composite Resources, we embrace a culture defined by teamwork, ownership, and accountability.

 Who we are looking for 

 A proven leader who will lead the expansion of our business into a new facility, new capabilities, and new high-volume production as we continue to rapidly grow our product mix, customer engagements, team members and facilities footprint. The ideal candidate has operational experience with manufacturing at scale, strong business acumen, a continuous improvement mentality, excellent coaching and motivational skills. Experience with advanced manufacturing, composites, aerospace, and/or defense technology are a plus. Prior experience with facility expansion and large scale capital projects is also preferred, as is experience working in a complex environment that includes front-end engineering customer designs and requirements for production.

 What you get to do 

 
 Lead the launch of a new production facility for high volume production and expansion of technical capabilities, ensuring continuity of production for current high-volume product lines and launch of new business.

 Manage the P&L - develop budgets, financial plans, and performance metrics, giving regular updates on progress and critical path items. Use financial metrics effectively to drive business improvements.

 Support the execution of commercial strategies, including engagement with government relations and business development resources.

 Lead, manage, and develop a high-performing team with a strong, positive operating culture, including Operations, Engineering, Technical Development, Quality, Finance, and Human Resources to ensure a high level of performance.

 Develop and implement operational strategies, priorities, and activities to ensure delivery on customer commitments and attainment of production, quality, and profitability objectives.

 Ensure the deployment of effective production systems, workflows, and performance metrics to ensure safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC) objectives are met.

 Support customer engagements to ensure the growth of our ongoing book of business.

 Provide leadership and management of Re:Builders to ensure effective selection, development, retention, and performance management of team members.

 Own ongoing performance KPIs and metrics and use them to drive improvement in operating performance and financial margins. 

 Leverage Lean operating principles and tools to reinforce an operating culture of continuous improvement.

 Develop and implement effective communication and engagement strategies to ensure teams are informed, aligned, and motivated to accomplish objectives.

 Lead budgeting and operations capacity planning for the business and monitor operational and financial metrics, take corrective actions where needed to support sustainable business growth.

 Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence aligned with the Principles of The Re:Build Way.

 
 What you bring to the team 

 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Operations, Business, or related field required; advanced degree (MBA, MS Engineering) strongly preferred.

 Over 15 years of progressive leadership experience in advanced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or related sectors.

 Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes, systems, supply chains, and regulatory environments are highly desirable.

 Demonstrated success in planning and developing business opportunities and being responsible for complex technology projects.

 Previous P&L responsibility and experience developing and managing budgets and financial plans.

 Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills.

 Outstanding communication and leadership skills with the ability to engage and influence diverse collaborators.

 Ability to thrive in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and navigate ambiguity with confidence.

 Willingness to travel as needed.

 
 The BIG payoff 

 We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

 Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

 We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate 

 Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

 Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufacturing.com or you may call us at 617.909.6275.
